name: manual_fb7628
claim: Independent dual-voice AI review (Codex + a separate Claude subagent, no shared context) that converges on the identical bug by reading the same code independently is the strongest verification signal available -- weight it above either voice's severity rating alone.

decisions.notes: In the same /autoplan session, both an internal Claude subagent and an external Codex CLI call independently found the exact same two bugs (hermes-delegate's as_completed()/timeout misuse causing a silent-forever deadlock, and hermes_spawn.sh's cleared-before-echo empty-PID bug) with zero shared context between them, across 2 separate review phases. A third independent voice (DX-phase subagent) found the same deadlock bug a third time. Cross-model replication, not stated severity, is the strongest confidence signal a multi-voice review can produce.
